title: Mid-Sem Exam Schedule Released
content: Mid-semester examination for Sem 3 all branches will start from 15th May 2026. Check Exam Timetable section for details.

title: Fee Payment Deadline
content: Last date for Sem 3 tuition fee payment is 30th April 2026. Late fee of Rs. 500 will be applied after the deadline.

title: College Annual Function
content: Annual Day celebration on 10th May 2026. All students are invited to participate in cultural and technical events.

title: Workshop on Python Programming
content: A 3-day workshop on Python & Machine Learning will be held from 5-7 May 2026 in CS Lab. Limited seats.

title: Library Book Return Notice
content: All students must return library books before 25th April 2026. Fines will be imposed for late returns.

title: Placement Drive Notice
content: TCS and Infosys placement drive scheduled for 20th May 2026. Eligible students should register in placement cell.

title: Holiday Notice - Buddha Purnima
content: College will remain closed on 12th May 2026 (Buddha Purnima). Classes will resume on 13th May.

title: Sports Day Registration
content: Annual sports day on 15th May 2026. Register with your department coordinator by 8th May.
